address: Les Monts de Vaux, Barretaine, 39800, France
bio: Dating back to the late 18C, this former coaching inn has been turned into a charming hotel (ten guestrooms, a swimming pool and spa) and a restaurant with three small dining areas and an intimate atmosphere. The chef-patron prepares modern cuisine using seasonal produce, much of which is sourced locally, some from the permaculture kitchen garden.
